performance_case.causal_mechanism: The 3 percent post-shock evaluator can produce forward mechanism evidence only when every diagnostic, outcome and cumulative snapshot follows the same uninterrupted canonical discovery-trigger lineage. Resolving the exact active rollover leaf and isolating artifacts by its fingerprint prevents silent evidence loss and cross-window contamination after a missed capture.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only an offline versioned capability: unchanged V1 behavior for the original root and deterministic V2 rebinding for a synthetic rollover successor, with no cross-lineage reuse. It proves no real successor exists yet, no live evidence was captured, no post-shock predictive value, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, strategy, candidate, OOS, deployment or Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Preventing predecessor and successor episodes from being pooled avoids a false breadth or stability claim, but any actual drawdown benefit remains MISSING_PROOF until untouched forward evidence supports a mechanism and a separately frozen equal-capital economic experiment passes path-risk gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded eight-file fix before the next normal rollover cycle is cheaper than allowing the post-shock lane to silently remain on a closed root or later rebuilding conclusions after contaminated lineage mixing. It keeps R2 and the sole cloud clock unchanged.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The knowledge value is preserving valid forward-evidence throughput for an already frozen mechanism test and preventing invalid evidence from reaching later strategy selection.
